description: This PHP source file defines the JobCategoryController class within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. The class extends an abstract Vue.js controller and overrides the preRender method to set up a Vue component named 'job-category-list'. It serves as part of the web application's backend responsible for managing job categories in the HRM system.

classes.name: JobCategoryController
classes.description: Controller class handling job category views in the admin plugin, extending the abstract Vue controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that sets the Vue component to 'job-category-list' for the view.
